periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique tilt approximately 50 degrees from the horizontal plane of the head, sloping toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; longitudinal axis is approximately 1.6 times the transverse axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering extending from the orbital center toward the maxillary region.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Approximately 40% of the visible vertical torso height at the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Gap between the black pinnae regions is approximately 1.5 times the width of a single pinna base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semicircular and rounded apex with visible high-frequency irregularities due to fur texture.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced beige/yellowish chromatic gradient on the neck fur contrasting with the white facial fur; open mandible posture exposing the oral cavity and dentition.
